name: Block Production DB Access
description: Prevents direct production database commands by detecting production hostnames, connection strings, and environment indicators
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block direct production database commands
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
# Check for production database indicators
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE '(psql|mysql|mongosh?|redis-cli)' && echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE '(prod|production|master\.db|main\.db|live)'; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Direct production database access detected. Use a read replica or staging environment."
  exit 2
fi
# Check for DATABASE_URL with production indicators
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qiE 'DATABASE_URL.*prod'; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Production DATABASE_URL detected. Use a staging connection."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
